name: Tag cloud
description: Example widget plugin: the values of a field as a cloud of tags, sized by count. Clicking a tag emits its rows.
author: fluid examples

widgets.label: Tag cloud
widgets.description: The values of a field, sized by how many rows have them.
widgets.llmDoc:
- { "id": string, "type": "tagcloud/cloud", "title"?: string, "span"?: 1..24,
    "data": { "query": "<queries key>", "path"?: "<dot path to the list>" }, "field": "<dot path of the value to count>", "max"?: number }
    A TAG CLOUD of the values of "field" (enums, tags, categories, names), each sized by how many rows have it ("max" tags, default 40).
    Clicking a tag emits { "value": <value>, "count": n, "rows": [ the rows having it ] } on "selected":
    pair it with a table bound to { "query": "@<this id>", "path": "selected.rows" } to list them (master/detail).

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The rows whose values are counted.

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: The clicked tag: { value, count, rows }.
